environment.description: Same application container image deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB configured with a mutual TLS listener. The ALB listener has 'MutualAuthentication' mode set to 'verify' with a trust store referencing an internal CA (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-ca-store/abc123). The ALB will terminate the TCP connection before forwarding if the client does not present a certificate signed by the internal CA. Additionally, the ECS task runs in a subnet with a Route53 Resolver DNS Firewall association that blocks resolution of any domain with a TTL below 5 seconds (custom rule group with BlockResponse=NXDOMAIN for low-TTL responses, priority 100). The task's security group allows egress only to port 443 on the VPC endpoint for SSM and to the ALB's security group; all other egress including to 169.254.169.254 is denied by an explicit deny rule. IMDSv2 is enforced with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 (though Fargate networking means the container is at hop 1).

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with mutual TLS, verify mode, trust store arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-ca-store/abc123
config.trust_store_ca: Internal PKI CA - only service mesh sidecars and authorized API gateways hold client certs
config.route53_resolver_firewall: Rule group blocks DNS responses with TTL < 5s (NXDOMAIN override), associated with task subnet
config.security_group_egress: allow 443 to vpce-ssm-sg only; deny 80/443 to 169.254.169.254/32; deny all other
config.network_acl_egress: deny 169.254.169.254/32, allow VPC CIDR and VPC endpoints only
